race.title: Coral 'Pipped-At-The-Post' And Win Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: WRECKLESS ERIC made a promising start in this sphere when runner-up at Ffos Las and can build on it to go one better off a handy-looking mark here. Last year's victor Ryan's Rocket is also of interest off his current mark and rates a big threat though, while both Un Sens A La Vie and Largy Belter command plenty of respect with better days still ahead. Pure Carbon and The Four Sixes complete the shortlist in this cracking handicap. WRECKLESS ERIC RYAN'S ROCKET (IRE) UN SENS A LA VIE (FR)
